component.name: SumMRIse
component.summary: View MRI and CT scans from hospital CDs

description.p: SumMRIse opens the DICOM images that hospitals hand out on CDs, DVDs and USB sticks. It shows every series with correct anatomical orientation, contrast presets, multiplanar reformatting (axial, coronal, sagittal, MIP) and the complete image metadata. All processing happens locally.
SumMRIse is not a medical device and must not be used for diagnosis.
